strings.ui.c3p2.check.title: Cross-check
strings.ui.c3p2.check.subtitle: C-17 series ledger against Alexei’s freight chain
strings.ui.c3p2.check.instruction: Beside each paper from Alexei’s freight chain, lay the entry that describes the same journey. Each pair shares exactly one detail.
strings.ui.c3p2.check.row.departures: Departures board · special 23:40 · platform 5 · empty run
strings.ui.c3p2.check.row.timetable: Karsk working timetable · three wagons with no destination
strings.ui.c3p2.check.card.in_c17_44: In 11 Feb, 9:52: wagon 4, seal C-17/44, 2410 kg “files”
strings.ui.c3p2.check.card.out_2340: Out 11 Feb, 23:40, platform 5: “escorted goods, 14 units” – Russian: 14 persons
strings.ui.c3p2.check.card.par_4: Annex C, § 4 (secretariat’s text): DE “escorted goods” – RU “escorted persons”
strings.ui.c3p2.check.card.january: In 14, 21, 28 Jan: three wagons from Karsk, C-17/41 to /43 – forwarded: Kordon-17, registration room
strings.ui.c3p2.check.wrong: At least one entry describes a different journey. Compare seals, times and wagons again.
strings.ui.c3p2.check.incomplete: First lay an entry beside every paper.
strings.ui.c3p2.check.hint: Read Alexei’s lines one at a time and find the same number in the ledger: seal, time, number of wagons. For the travel order, Elena’s marginal note on paragraph four helps.
strings.ui.c3p2.check.success: Every journey has two papers. On the scales it says files, in the registry escorted goods, in the Russian column persons. And every route ends in the same place: Kordon-17, registration room.
strings.ui.c3p2.check.error: The cross-check can’t be verified right now. {error}
strings.ui.c3p2.check.slot_tip: Paper {n} – click so the next entry goes here
strings.ui.c3p2.check.slot_filled: Paper {n}: {name} – click to take the entry back
strings.ui.c3p2.check.card_tip: {name} – click: into the next free row · drag: onto a particular row
strings.ui.c3p2.check.controls: 1–4 place entry · Backspace take back last entry · R take back all · Enter check · Esc close · Mouse: drag an entry onto a row; clicking an empty row selects it for the next entry
strings.ui.c3p2.check.kordon_note: All four journeys end in the same place.
strings.ui.c3p2.check.tip_mouse: With the mouse: drag an entry onto a row – or click an empty row first, then the entry. Clicking a placed entry takes it back.
strings.ui.c3p2.check.tip_pad: With a controller: A places the selected entry in the next free row – or pick an empty row with A first. X takes back the last entry, Y checks, B cancels the selection.
